description.value: Thomson Creek is a nature reserve in Kelowna, BC, managed by the City of Kelowna as part of its parks and natural areas network. Situated along a creek corridor, it offers a natural green space within the Okanagan landscape that touring cyclists may find useful as a rest stop or scenic detour. As a City of Kelowna property, it is publicly accessible.
